desc: Detect all directed cycles using indegree peeling and enumerate each cycle/component.
Compute bottom-up tree DP for non-cycle vertices and attached children of cycle vertices, with correct inequality direction and modular prefix sums.
Combine each cycle’s attached-tree contributions for a common value, including self-loops, and multiply all component counts.
Validate complexity \(O(NM)\), indexing, modulo operations, and edge cases such as \(N=1\), \(M=1\), and constant outgoing edges.
